title_zh: 核对材质后选定便于旅行的真丝围巾

scenario.label_zh: 旅行围巾材质与体积选择
scenario.goal_zh: 查看材质标签并比较收纳体积，选定较薄的真丝围巾作为旅行礼物

context_zh: 顾客为经常出行的成年朋友挑选轻便围巾。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: This scarf feels very light. Is it silk, or a fabric that just looks like it?

sentences.speaker: Shop assistant
sentences.text: The label says one hundred percent silk. This other scarf is wool and takes up more space.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: The gift is for a friend who travels with one small bag. Could you fold both so I can compare them?

sentences.speaker: Shop assistant
sentences.text: Of course. Here they are side by side.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: The thinner one will fit more easily. I will take the silk scarf, please.

sentences.speaker: Shop assistant
sentences.text: Certainly. Would you like it in a small gift envelope rather than a box?

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: Yes, that would be perfect for the bag.
